claims: Eid al-Fitr 2026 is expected to begin around Friday, March 20, 2026.
Eid al-Fitr marks the end of Ramadan.
Islamic holidays depend on the sighting of the new moon.
Most predictions, including for the USA, India, and Saudi Arabia, point to March 20, 2026, as the first day of Shawwal.
Governments in some regions, such as Egypt, have indicated a public holiday period from Thursday, March 19, to Monday, March 23, 2026.
Eid al-Fitr is the "Festival of Breaking the Fast".
The exact date of Eid al-Fitr 2026 is subject to local moon sightings, particularly by local religious authorities.
